method: Human-visible review of native XCTest contact sheets, selected original PNGs, and normalized side-by-side reference comparisons. Screenshots are grouped by exact source/test round; historical failures are retained.
completedChecks: Final c401a11 iPhone 16e and iPad mini light/dark main screens, import panels and no-farm states.
Reference and native screen in one normalized comparison: system typography, layout rhythm, palette/contrast, pixel artwork and data-backed copy.
Focused grid and management/navigation regions: full six-tool grid, complete backup rows at 390pt, fixed save footer and valid native tab symbols.

Every full-mini contact sheet (10) and full-iphone contact sheet (18), including portrait/landscape editors, accessibility sizes, map, inventory, appearance, house, tools/equipment, collection and recipe states.
All 31 final Brand UI screenshots per device: 17 editor entries, category selection, search result and empty state, review, QQ copy/image/share sheet.
Final 375pt accessibility appearance selector originals and open menu: value remains in its own vertical row, menu options readable and selection tested.
Final accessibility tool directory: single-column wrapped labels and reachable fixed review action.
Final map scoped watering preview, pending search and located crop screenshots; native journey also verifies undo.
Baseline local library and export flow screens; underlying persistence and export implementation unchanged by final UI fixes.
Final overview, focused comparison, appearance repair, interaction and persistence/responsive evidence sheets inspected after generation.
